name: Accrual v1.3.23
changelog: Audit & remediasi menyeluruh Apple Shortcuts & App Intents
Pembersihan duplikasi aksi pintasan di Shortcuts library via isDiscoverable guard
Standardisasi lokalisasi murni 100% tanpa istilah campuran gado-gado
Perbaikan parameter pencatatan notifikasi bank (BCA, Mandiri, BRImo, BNI, GoPay, OVO)
Penyempurnaan pemindai layar Back Tap dengan pembersihan token Unicode dan OCR otomatis
changelog_en: Comprehensive Apple Shortcuts & App Intents audit and remediation
Eliminated duplicate actions in Shortcuts library using isDiscoverable guard
Enforced 100% pure non-mixed localization across all shortcut guides and intents
Fixed bank notification automation parameters for BCA, Mandiri, BRImo, BNI, GoPay, OVO
Hardened Back Tap screen scanner with Unicode token strip and fallback Vision OCR
